messages:
mira: Heads-up: noticed several interviews created during last night's deploy have empty scorecards. Could be the new recruiter UI bug.

devin: confirmed, I see ~28 interviews missing scorecard_id. Probably the mapping service returned 500 for some flows.

raja: are these across roles or concentrated?

devin: mostly new grad and IC2 backend loop flows. Senior roles look fine.

mira: plan: 1) dry-run backfill that only assigns scorecards when scorecard_id is null, 2) run small sample and post CSV, 3) apply and alert.

devin: dry-run command I used:

```
python infra/ats_fix.py --start=2025-12-02 --end=2025-12-03 --dry-run --role-filter="new grad,ic2"
```

recruiting-bot: backfill queued (job=90021). ETA 60s.

devin: dry-run complete: 28 candidates would be updated. sample: cand-9021 int-1334 -> assign "Panel - IC2". No overwrites.

raja: good. mira, can you sanity-check mappings for "IC2 - Backend" so we don't accidentally attach the wrong rubric?

mira: checked. mapping table looks correct. proceed when ready.

devin: applying now (will include CSV of ids and a slack ping if >10 updates).

recruiting-bot: backfill finished. job=90021. 28 updates. details: https://internal/logs/90021

devin: log snippet:
```
2025-12-03T02:12:12Z INFO updated int-1334 scorecard_id=panel-ic2-backend
2025-12-03T02:12:13Z INFO updated int-1339 scorecard_id=panel-ic2-backend
```

raja: spot-check ok.

mira: follow-ups: 1) create a short doc for recruiters about the new UI failure mode; 2) schedule a 15-min sync with recruitment team next Tues to review. I'll draft the doc and share.

devin: I'll add a retry and better logging to the mapping service to reduce recurrence.

mira: thanks. closing after doc + retry deployed. :white_check_mark:
